# egy.one

> egy.one is the Egypt gateway for Egyptian brands: one door to UGC campaigns, influencer relations, content production, performance marketing and social media management — delivered by an Egyptian team working the local market from the inside, with on-the-ground coverage in ten cities and districts and digital campaigns reaching all of Egypt.

## Services (Egypt gateway)

- UGC Campaigns: short videos from real creators who try the product and talk about it in natural Egyptian — ready for publishing and advertising, with usage rights written before filming.
- Influencer PR: a natural brand presence inside influencers' content — considered product gifting, launch and event invitations, and lasting creator relationships, with a full coverage report at the campaign's end.
- Content Production: visual content filmed inside Egypt — commercials, product videos and event coverage — with cinematic lighting and grading and versions in every platform size.
- Performance Marketing: paid campaigns fed by the content produced in-house, so the ad starts from a real video rather than a design template, with reporting on what worked and what stopped.
- Social Media Management: brand accounts run on a steady monthly content plan — production, copywriting, publishing and follow-up — in the brand's voice and the rhythm of the Egyptian market.

## Coverage inside Egypt

On-the-ground execution in Cairo, Giza, 6th of October City, New Cairo, Obour, Maadi, Nasr City, Alexandria, Mansoura and Tanta — each with local creator lists and filming locations, because Greater Cairo alone is not one market and every region has its own voice. Digital campaigns reach every governorate.

## How a request moves (4 steps)

1. Free consultation — the product, the market, the audience, and the result success is measured by.
2. Written plan & shortlist — proposed services and a creator or influencer list that genuinely fits, approved by the client before any step.
3. Execution & follow-up — filming, campaigns or account management with direct follow-up, step by step.
4. Delivery & report — the content or coverage in full, with a clear report: what was done, what it achieved, and what comes next.

## Guides (on the homepages)

Practical, answer-first guides published free on the egy.one homepages:

- How to choose a marketing agency in Egypt — the questions and the red flags (https://egy.one/en.html#guides): ask who actually does the work (a fixed in-house team or freelancers assembled per project), settle content and raw-footage rights (whose, where, for how long), and ask for a real sample report. Red flags: guaranteed-number promises and prices with no written scope. Arabic: https://egy.one/#guides
- The UGC that actually works in the Egyptian market (https://egy.one/en.html#guides): the video that sells here speaks natural Egyptian — a translated script or heavy formal Arabic reads instantly as a foreign ad; a creator who resembles the customer beats a star passing over many products; the "how much?" question is part of the content and is answered with value; purchase journeys often close on WhatsApp; and seasons (Ramadan, summer, back-to-school) change everything. Arabic: https://egy.one/#guides
- Cairo, Alexandria and the Delta: not one market with one voice (https://egy.one/en.html#guides): Greater Cairo runs on speed and variety — and even inside it every district is a different audience; Alexandria has a clear local pride and a summer season that changes the city's whole rhythm; in the Delta, trust travels person to person and practical proof wins. Decide who and where first, then build the content on the answer. Arabic: https://egy.one/#guides
